## Setup

```{r packages + settings}
library(tidyverse)
library(socsci)
library(geomtextpath)
library(coolorrr)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggridges)
library(here)
library(countrycode)
library(patchwork)
set_palette(
  qualitative = c(
    "steelblue",
    "orange",
    "navy",
    "red",
    "green3"
  ),
  binary = c("navy", "orange"),
  sequential = c("white", "navy"),
  diverging = c("steelblue", "gray30", "red3")
)
source(here::here("_helpers", "splot.R"))
theme_set(my_theme())
saveit <- function(num = 1, ht = 5, wd = 7) {
  ggsave(
    here::here(
      "119_second_image_rev",
      paste0("fig", num, ".png")
    ),
    height = ht,
    width = wd,
    dpi = 500
  )
}
```


## Data

```{r}
library(peacesciencer)
library(globalmacrodata)
library(inflateR)
```

```{r}
## code to load, clean, and merge the data
create_dyadyears(
  subset_years = 1960:2014
) |>
  add_cow_mids() -> ddy

ddy |>
  group_by(ccode1, year) |>
  summarize(
    mids_n = sum(cowmidongoing),
    mids_p = mean(cowmidongoing)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  rename(ccode = ccode1) -> dt

create_stateyears() |>
  add_cow_trade() -> trd_dt

dt |>
  left_join(trd_dt) -> dt

gmd() -> gm_dt

gm_dt |>
  transmute(
    ccode = countrycode(ISO3, "iso3c", "cown"),
    year,
    infl,
    rGDP_USD,
    pop
  ) -> gm_dt

dt |>
  left_join(gm_dt) -> dt
```

```{r}
tibble(
  year = 1960:2014,
  k = map_dbl(
      year, ~ adjust_inflation(
      1, .x, "USD", to_year = 2015
    )
  )
) -> infl_dt

dt |>
  left_join(infl_dt) -> dt

dt |>
  mutate(
    imports = k * imports,
    exports = k * exports
  ) -> dt
```



```{r}
dt |>
  group_by(ccode) |>
  mutate(
    imports_lag = lag(imports, order_by = year),
    exports_lag = lag(exports, order_by = year)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    imports_d = (imports - imports_lag)/imports_lag,
    exports_d = (exports - exports_lag)/exports_lag
  ) -> dt
```



## Analysis

```{r}
library(estimatr)
lm_robust(
  asinh(infl) ~ asinh(mids_n) + asinh(imports_lag + exports_lag),
  data = dt,
  se_type = "stata",
  fixed_effects = ~ ccode,
  clusters = ccode
)
```



```{r}
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
dt |>
  mutate(
    mids = ifelse(mids_n > 0, "Yes", "No") |> as.factor(),
    infl = asinh(infl),
    trade = asinh(imports_lag + exports_lag)
  ) |>
  lm(
    infl ~ mids_n + trade + 
      as.factor(ccode), 
    data = _
  ) %>%
  coeftest(
    vcov. = vcovBS(x = .)
  )
```


```{r}
dt |>
  mutate(
    mids = ifelse(mids_n > 0, "Yes", "No") |> as.factor(),
    infl = asinh(infl),
    trade_lag = imports_lag + exports_lag,
    trade = imports + exports
  ) -> dt
```


```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7
dt |>
  group_by(mids) |>
  mutate(infl = sinh(infl)) |>
  mean_ci(infl, ci = .84) |>
  splot(
    mids, mean, ymin = lower, ymax = upper,
    type = "pointrange",
    title = "Int'l Conflict = Higher Inflation",
    subtitle = "Avg. % Inflation, 1960-2014, by MID involvement",
    xlab = "Involved in a Militarized Interstate Dispute?",
    ylab = "% Inflation (84% CIs)"
  ) 
saveit(1)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-width: 7

ggplot(dt) +
  aes(trade / 1e03, sinh(infl)) +
  geom_smooth(color = "navy", method = "lm", alpha = .4, formula = y ~ poly(x, 3)) +
  labs(
    title = "More Trade = Lower Inflation",
    subtitle = "Smoothed avg. % inflation by trade",
    x = "Log-10 of Total Trade (Billions of 2015 USD)",
    y = "% Inflation",
    caption = logo
  ) +
  scale_x_log10(
    n.breaks = 6,
    labels = scales::dollar
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
saveit(2)
```
